item.title: Your Stories Q&A: Stalled renovation project in Oswego County gets new life with new owner
item.description: The historic John Beck's Hotel in the Village of Mexico is being renovated with the help of a $1.8 million New York Restore Grant, and a local developer has purchased the building with plans to open a restaurant, café, hotel and luxury apartments.

item.title: John Wildhack to retire as SU Director of Athletics
item.description: John Wildhack has announced his resignation as Director of Athletics at Syracuse University after 10 years in the role, coinciding with the departure of Chancellor Kent Syverud.

item.title: Latasha Mott to spend 23 years to life in prison after admitting to murdering 5-year-old daughter Nefertiti Harris
item.description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. (WSYR-TV) -- A woman who admitted to murdering her 5-year-old daughter learned her fate Wednesday morning, Feb. 11. A judge sentenced Latasha Mott to spend 23 years to life in state prison after pleading guilty to intentionally causing the death of her 5-year-old daughter, Nefertiti Harris, by beating her. item.title: Push for 'Invest in Our New York' tax hikes on Tin Cup Day
item.description: Advocates, activists, and elected officials gathered at the New York State Capitol to demand higher taxes on the state's wealthiest residents and corporations to generate billions to protect childcare and healthcare from federal budget cuts.

item.title: National Grid investigating issue that may be causing your lights to flicker
item.description: National Grid is investigating a transmission line issue in Central New York after some residents reported flickering lights, but there are no outages currently related to the issue.

item.title: LaFayette man who threw a deer head at ICE protestors apologizes in court
item.description: Antonio Pizzuto apologized in court for throwing a severed deer head at ICE protestors in January and was required to complete 20 hours of community service, with the charges to be dismissed if he meets the requirements and stays out of trouble.
